buildings.name: Administrative Block (Main Building)
buildings.description: Houses the Principal's Office, Administrative Desks, Examination Section, Accounts, and Academic Dean offices.
buildings.verificationNotes: Verified from MCE institutional records and front Salagame Road orientation.

buildings.name: Computer Science & Information Science Complex
buildings.description: Departments of Computer Science & Engineering, Information Science & Engineering, and CSE (AI & ML). Features high-performance computing labs, server rooms, and faculty chambers.
buildings.verificationNotes: Verified building complex in the central academic zone.

buildings.name: Civil Engineering Department (CED)
buildings.description: One of the foundation departments of MCE (est. 1960). Houses Basic Material Testing Lab, Geotechnical Lab, Environmental Lab, Concrete & Highway Materials Testing Labs.

buildings.name: Mechanical Engineering Complex & Workshops
buildings.description: Contains thermal engineering labs, fluid mechanics bays, foundry, machine shop, and advanced manufacturing suites.
buildings.verificationNotes: Verified workshop bays north of the civil quadrangle.

buildings.name: Electronics & Communication Engineering Block
buildings.description: Specialized laboratories for VLSI design, DSP, Embedded Systems, Communication systems, and Microcontrollers.

buildings.name: Electrical & Electronics & Instrumentation Block
buildings.description: Houses Power Systems, High Voltage, Electrical Machines, and Process Instrumentation labs.

buildings.name: MCE Central Library & Digital Information Centre
buildings.description: Over 94,000+ volumes, IEEE digital access terminal, study cubicles, VTU consortium hub, and 300+ seat reading hall.

buildings.name: Training & Placement Centre & MCE Auditorium
buildings.description: Auditorium for college symposiums, placement interview rooms, group discussion halls, and pre-placement briefing theater.

buildings.name: ME-RIISE Foundation & AICTE IDEA-Lab
buildings.description: Technology Business Incubator (TBI), startup prototyping labs, 3D printers, laser cutters, and entrepreneurship cells.

buildings.name: Boys Hostels Complex (Hoysala, Hemavathi & Hasanamba)
buildings.description: On-campus residential quarters for male students with dining hall, study lounges, and solar hot water facilities.

buildings.name: Campus Canteen & Student Dining Hub
buildings.description: Subsidized fresh meals, breakfast, coffee bar, and social seating area for students and faculty.

buildings.name: MCE Sports Complex & Athletic Grounds
buildings.description: Full-size cricket/football field, indoor badminton/table tennis stadium, gymnasium, and basketball courts.

buildings.name: Spiritual Enclave (Shree Ganapathi Temple & Dhyana Mandira)
buildings.description: Divya Chaithanya center for yoga, meditation, peace, and spiritual well-being located in the calm northern garden.
buildings.verificationNotes: Verified landmark temple and meditation hall.

buildings.name: Main Security Gate & Visitor Post
buildings.description: Primary campus entrance on Salagame Road with 24/7 security watch, vehicular barrier, and identity verification.
buildings.verificationNotes: Verified main entrance on Salagame Road.

buildings.name: Campus Health & First Aid Centre
buildings.description: Emergency primary care, on-call physician, nursing staff, basic triage, and emergency stretcher transfer station.
buildings.verificationNotes: Verified health post near main gate.
